policy: Raw runtime capabilities are crate-private implementation details of observable lifecycle owners; detached spawning has no public entry point.

entries.termination: The application RuntimeOwner terminates the underlying Tokio runtime.
entries.join_or_deadline: Only RuntimeOwner, TaskGroup, and crate-private runtime adapters can reach this handle; TaskGroup shutdown supplies the join deadline.
entries.metrics: RuntimeDiagnostics and the owning TaskGroup shutdown report.
entries.reason: Tokio integration requires a raw handle inside the lifecycle owner, but it is not nameable by downstream crates.

entries.termination: Each compatibility adapter immediately wraps the ambient runtime in a TaskGroup-backed scheduler.
entries.join_or_deadline: ScheduledTaskGroup or ServiceManager shutdown joins work with a bounded report.
entries.reason: Legacy scheduler construction is isolated inside the runtime crate and cannot expose RuntimeHandle to callers.
